title: Euromonitor identifies five consumer trends set to shape 2027
summary: Trust, transparency, reliability and tangible benefits are becoming increasingly important as consumers reassess their relationships with brands. Euromonitor International's latest report highlights five behavioural shifts with implications for the beauty industry. Consumers are becoming more selective about the brands they trust, more cautious about their spending and increasingly demanding when it comes to the value they receive.
